gloss: place one has gone out to; destination when out; where one is while out

definitions.gloss: place one has gone out to; destination when out; while out
definitions.explanation: Where someone is when they're out of the house or office — the workplace they've visited, a café, a station, etc. Often appears with で to mean "while out and about."

examples.japanese: {外出先|がいしゅつさき}で{財布|さいふ}をなくした。
examples.english: I lost my wallet while I was out.

examples.japanese: {外出先|がいしゅつさき}から{会社|かいしゃ}に{連絡|れんらく}を{入|い}れた。
examples.english: I contacted the office from where I was visiting.

examples.japanese: {外出先|がいしゅつさき}でもスマホがあれば{仕事|しごと}のメールを{確認|かくにん}できる。
examples.english: Even when I'm out, I can check work email as long as I have my smartphone.

notes:
Compound of {外出|がいしゅつ} (going out) + {先|さき} (destination, place of). The {先|さき} suffix is the same one in {勤務先|きんむさき} (workplace) and {連絡先|れんらくさき} (contact info).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {外出先|がいしゅつさき}で: while out
- {外出先|がいしゅつさき}から: from where one has gone
- {外出先|がいしゅつさき}を{伝|つた}える: to share where one is going

USAGE:
Very common in announcements and modern work-from-anywhere contexts: {外出先|がいしゅつさき}でも{対応|たいおう}{可能|かのう} ("can respond even when out"). Less common in casual conversation, where people usually name the specific place instead.
